blocks.heading: What is TR60?
blocks.body: Dual incretin pathway profile for glucose and body-composition research. Coze describes Tirzepatide as a 39-amino-acid dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist that supports glucose-dependent insulin secretion, glucagon suppression, delayed gastric emptying, and appetite-pathway research. Tirzepatide 30mg is mapped to LPPeptide SKU TR30. Current storefront values use our product data: 30mg x 10 vials /box, $105.00 USD per box. LPPeptide reference specs: 5mg x 10 vials / 10mg x 10 vials / 15mg x 10 vials / 20mg x 10 vials / 30mg x 10 vials / 40mg x 10 vials / 60mg x 10 vials / 100mg x 10 vials.

blocks.heading: LPPeptide handling reference
blocks.body:
Coze source: add 3.0 mL sterile water for 10.0 mg/mL. Reference range is once weekly 2.5-15 mg with stepwise adjustment about every 4 weeks. At 10.0 mg/mL, 1 U equals 100 mcg.

Coze preparation pattern: use sterile technique, add diluent slowly down the vial wall, avoid foaming, roll gently until dissolved, label the preparation date, refrigerate at 2-8 deg C, and protect from light.

blocks.heading: Safety observations
blocks.body: Commonly discussed observations include gastrointestinal pathway effects, appetite changes, dehydration risk in models, and limited compatibility data with adjacent compounds.

blocks.heading: Contraindications
blocks.body: Do not use TR60 outside qualified research workflows. Review the current SDS, COA, and protocol exclusions before handling.

blocks.heading: Interaction review
blocks.body: Avoid unreviewed combinations with other incretin, insulin, glucose-lowering, or gastric-motility pathway studies.
